clips.title: The story
paras: At Remtravel's Excavation, Prospector Remtravel's dig has broken into ancient ruins.

Prospector Remtravel came to southern Darkshore seeking relics from the distant past. He established a large dig far from Auberdine's safety. As his team cut through ancient layers of earth, they uncovered Gravelflint troggs and hulking stone golems buried below. The creatures overran the quarry, scattering the miners. Remtravel now scrambles to recover his most promising finds.
